flags.description: Compilation flags substituted into the template. Leave unset to use the template's own default.

CmsContestSettings.description:
Settings of the CMS contest itself.

The limits here count across all tasks.

maxSubmissionNumber.description: Most submissions a contestant may make (`max_submission_number`).
maxSubmissionNumber.title: Maxsubmissionnumber

maxUserTestNumber.description: Most user tests a contestant may run (`max_user_test_number`).
maxUserTestNumber.title: Maxusertestnumber

minSubmissionInterval.description: Seconds a contestant must wait between two submissions (`min_submission_interval`).
minSubmissionInterval.title: Minsubmissioninterval

minUserTestInterval.description: Seconds a contestant must wait between two user tests (`min_user_test_interval`).
minUserTestInterval.title: Minusertestinterval

scorePrecision.description: Decimal places scores are shown with (`score_precision`).
scorePrecision.title: Scoreprecision

tokens.description: Tokens. A contestant may use one on a task only when both the contest and the task allow it.

start.description: When the contest starts (`start`), with a UTC offset, such as `2026-09-28T08:00:00-03:00`. `contest.rbx.yml` only.
start.title: Start

stop.description: When the contest ends (`stop`), with a UTC offset. `contest.rbx.yml` only.
stop.title: Stop

perUserTime.description: Seconds each contestant gets, starting when they choose to, within the contest window (`per_user_time`). `contest.rbx.yml` only.
perUserTime.title: Perusertime

timezone.description: IANA name of the timezone CMS shows times in (`timezone`), such as `America/Sao_Paulo`. Separate from the UTC offsets on `start` and `stop`.
timezone.title: Timezone

allowUserTests.description: Whether contestants may run their code on their own inputs (`allow_user_tests`).
allowUserTests.title: Allowusertests

submissionsDownloadAllowed.description: Whether contestants may download their submissions (`submissions_download_allowed`).
submissionsDownloadAllowed.title: Submissionsdownloadallowed

allowPasswordAuthentication.description: Whether contestants may log in with a password (`allow_password_authentication`).
allowPasswordAuthentication.title: Allowpasswordauthentication

ipRestriction.description: Whether a contestant may log in only from their own IP addresses (`ip_restriction`).
ipRestriction.title: Iprestriction

ipAutologin.description: Whether a contestant is logged in from their IP address, without a password (`ip_autologin`).
ipAutologin.title: Ipautologin

blockHiddenParticipations.description: Whether hidden participations are kept from logging in (`block_hidden_participations`).
blockHiddenParticipations.title: Blockhiddenparticipations

allowedLocalizations.description: Interface languages contestants may pick, such as `en` and `pt_BR` (`allowed_localizations`). Unset or empty allows them all.
allowedLocalizations.title: Allowedlocalizations

CmsContestSettings.title: CmsContestSettings

CmsLanguageExtension.description: CMS settings of one language in `env.rbx.yml`.

languages.description: CMS languages this rbx language maps to, by the exact name CMS gives them, such as `C++20 / g++`, `Java / JDK` or `Python 3 / PyPy`. A contest package allows every language of every rbx language's list. Unset, or empty, means the language has no CMS counterpart.
languages.title: Languages

flags.description: Flags `g++` gets when the CMS host compiles a checker or interactor written in this language, such as `-std=gnu++17 -O2`. rbx always adds `-static` and the include and define flags it needs. Unset means `-std=gnu++20 -O2`. Graders and stubs are compiled by CMS with its own per-language commands, which this does not change.
flags.title: Flags

CmsTaskSettings.description:
Settings applied to every task of the contest.

The limits here apply to each task separately.

maxSubmissionNumber.description: Most submissions a contestant may make (`max_submission_number`).
maxSubmissionNumber.title: Maxsubmissionnumber

maxUserTestNumber.description: Most user tests a contestant may run (`max_user_test_number`).
maxUserTestNumber.title: Maxusertestnumber

minSubmissionInterval.description: Seconds a contestant must wait between two submissions (`min_submission_interval`).
minSubmissionInterval.title: Minsubmissioninterval

minUserTestInterval.description: Seconds a contestant must wait between two user tests (`min_user_test_interval`).
minUserTestInterval.title: Minusertestinterval

scorePrecision.description: Decimal places scores are shown with (`score_precision`).
scorePrecision.title: Scoreprecision

tokens.description: Tokens. A contestant may use one on a task only when both the contest and the task allow it.

scoreMode.description: How the task score comes out of a contestant's submissions (`score_mode`). `max`: the best submission. `maxSubtask`: the best score on each subtask, summed across submissions. `maxTokenedLast`: the best of the tokened submissions and the last one. Defaults to `max`, which is what rbx means by a solution's score; CMS's own default is `maxTokenedLast`.

feedbackLevel.description: How much contestants see about a submission on its public testcases (`feedback_level`). `full`: every testcase's outcome, time and memory. `restricted`: less.

publicTestcases.description: Which testcases contestants see results for. `samples`: the tests of the `samples` group. `all`: every test. `none`: no test. Defaults to `samples`.

CmsTaskSettings.title: CmsTaskSettings

CmsTokens.description: CMS tokens. Replaced as a whole when a contest overrides a preset.

mode.description: `disabled`: no tokens. `infinite`: a contestant may token every submission. `finite`: tokens are generated over time, as the fields below say. Written to CMS's `token_mode`.

maxNumber.description: Most tokens a contestant may use in total (`token_max_number`). Unset means no cap. `finite` mode only.
maxNumber.title: Maxnumber

minInterval.description: Seconds a contestant must wait between two tokens (`token_min_interval`). `finite` mode only.
minInterval.title: Mininterval

genInitial.description: Tokens a contestant starts with (`token_gen_initial`). `finite` mode only.
genInitial.title: Geninitial

genInterval.description: Seconds between two generations (`token_gen_interval`). `finite` mode only.
genInterval.title: Geninterval

genMax.description: Most tokens a contestant may hold at once (`token_gen_max`). Unset means no cap. `finite` mode only.
genMax.title: Genmax

CmsTokens.title: CmsTokens

DomjudgeExtension.description:
Environment-level extensions for DOMjudge tooling.

The four limits DOMjudge keeps in its own configuration that rbx has an
opinion about. Spelled in rbx's units and converted on the way out.

memoryLimit.description: Default memory limit (in MiB) for submissions on the server, written to DOMjudge's `memory_limit`. A problem package carries its own memory limit, so this is only the fallback for problems that do not. Leave unset to keep whatever the server has.
memoryLimit.title: Memorylimit

outputLimit.description: Default output limit (in KiB), written to DOMjudge's `output_limit`. Leave unset to keep whatever the server has.
outputLimit.title: Outputlimit

processLimit.description: Maximum number of processes a submission may run, written to DOMjudge's `process_limit`. Leave unset to keep whatever the server has.
processLimit.title: Processlimit

sourceSizeLimit.description: Maximum size (in KiB) of a submitted source file, written to DOMjudge's `sourcesize_limit`. Leave unset to keep whatever the server has.
sourceSizeLimit.title: Sourcesizelimit

DomjudgeExtension.title: DomjudgeExtension

languages.description: DOMjudge language ids this rbx language maps to. Leave unset to let rbx match by file extension against the server's own language list. Set it when the match is wrong, or when the language is currently disabled on the server -- a disabled language is invisible to the API. DOMjudge matches these against a language's `externalid`, which is not always the id shown in the admin UI (`py3` is externalid `python3`, `pas` is `pascal`).
languages.title: Languages

timeFactor.description: Multiplier DOMjudge applies to every problem's time limit for this language (`time_factor`). Leave unset to keep the factor the server has. rbx has no environment setting that means the same thing, so this is never derived: `timing.wallTimeMultiplier` is about wall versus CPU time, and a timing group's `whenEmpty.multiplier` only estimates a limit for a group that has no solutions.
timeFactor.title: Timefactor

compile.description: Whether to push this language's compile script to the server, built from `compileCommand` or from the language's own `compilation.commands`. Set to false to enable the language but leave the server's compile script alone.
compile.title: Compile

compileCommand.description: Compilation command to send to DOMjudge instead of the language's `compilation.commands`. Same placeholders (`{compilable}`, `{executable}`). Useful when the judge needs flags the local environment does not want, `-static` being the usual one.
compileCommand.title: Compilecommand

thresholds.description: Thresholds for the issues that measure a size or a duration.

name.description: Identifier of this language within this environment.
name.title: Name

extension.description:
File extension supported by this language. If there's only one language
that supports a certain file extension in the environment, the tool
will automatically identify the language based on such extension.
extension.title: Extension

extraExtensions.description:
Extra file extensions supported by this language. If not specified, the tool
will automatically identify the language based on such extensions.
extraExtensions.title: Extraextensions

execution.description: Execution config to use when running programs for this language.

fileMapping.description:
Mapping for files within the sandbox. If not specified, the default mapping
for the environment will be used.

extensions.description: Extensions to apply for this language.

linters.description: Linters to run for this language during compilation.
linters.title: Linters

scanners.description:
Dependency scanners (by registry name) to apply for this
language, in addition to the ones automatically selected by language kind.
scanners.title: Scanners

timing.description: Per-language overrides for timing configuration (e.g. wall time).

maxProcesses.description: Max. number of process to allow to run concurrently for the program.
maxProcesses.title: Maxprocesses

timeLimit.description: Time limit in milliseconds to allow the program to run.
timeLimit.title: Timelimit

wallTimeLimit.description: Wall time limit in milliseconds to allow the program to run.
wallTimeLimit.title: Walltimelimit

stackLimit.description:
Stack limit in MiB. Only enforced on Linux; ignored on macOS,
where the stack is whatever the host shell provides. When unset, the stack is
made as large as the system allows.
stackLimit.title: Stacklimit

preserveEnv.description: Whether to preserve env. variables coming from the host.
preserveEnv.title: Preserveenv

mirrorDirs.description: Directories in the host that should be read-only exposed to the sandbox.
mirrorDirs.title: Mirrordirs

sandbox.description: Sandbox configuration to use when executing for this language.

solutionOverrides.description: Overrides to apply when executing solutions for this language.

cms.description: Default CMS contest and task settings, which a contest overrides field by field.

input.description:
Path where to copy the stdin file to before running the program,
relative to the sandbox root.
input.title: Input

output.description:
Path where to output the stdout file after running the program,
relative to the sandbox root.
output.title: Output

error.description:
Path where to output the stderr file after running the program,
relative to the sandbox root.
error.title: Error

capture.description:
Path where to output the capture file after running the program,

capture.title: Capture

compilable.description:
Path where to copy the compilable file to before compiling the program,
relative to the sandbox root.
compilable.title: Compilable

executable.description:
Path to where to output the executable file after compiling the program,
relative to the sandbox root.
executable.title: Executable

IssueThresholds.description: How large or slow something may be before an issue reports it.

testsetSizeMb.description:
Largest total size, in MiB, of the built testset (every input plus
every expected answer) before `large-testset` is reported.
testsetSizeMb.title: Testsetsizemb

testcaseInputSizeMb.description:
Largest size, in MiB, of a single built input before `large-testcase`
is reported.
testcaseInputSizeMb.title: Testcaseinputsizemb

testcaseAnswerSizeMb.description:
Largest size, in MiB, of a single expected answer before
`large-testcase` is reported.
testcaseAnswerSizeMb.title: Testcaseanswersizemb

acceptedTotalTimeSeconds.description:
Largest total CPU time, in seconds, an accepted solution may spend
over the whole testset before `slow-accepted-solution` is reported.
acceptedTotalTimeSeconds.title: Acceptedtotaltimeseconds

stderrSizeMb.description:
Largest stderr, in MiB, a solution may write on a single testcase
before `noisy-stderr` is reported.
stderrSizeMb.title: Stderrsizemb

whenEmpty.description: How to derive a TL for this group when it has no solutions.

relativeTo.description:
A language name whose group's estimated TL this empty group is
relative to. If omitted, the multiplier is applied to the base estimate.
relativeTo.title: Relativeto

multiplier.description:
Slope applied to the reference TL when this group has no
solutions. The resolved TL is ``multiplier * reference + increment``.
multiplier.title: Multiplier

increment.description:
Constant offset (in milliseconds) added on top of the
multiplied reference TL when this group has no solutions. The resolved TL is
``multiplier * reference + increment``.
increment.title: Increment

wallTimeMultiplier.description: Overrides the environment wall-time multiplier `a` for this language.
wallTimeMultiplier.title: Walltimemultiplier

wallTimeIncrement.description: Overrides the environment wall-time increment `b` (in milliseconds) for this language.
wallTimeIncrement.title: Walltimeincrement

time.description: Value to override time limit with, in milliseconds.
time.title: Time

configuredTime.description: The declared time limit, in milliseconds, regardless of whether it is enforced for a given run. ``time`` is nulled to signal "do not enforce a TL", which loses the declared value; this preserves it for display/reporting.
configuredTime.title: Configuredtime

memory.description: Value to override memory limit with, in MB.
memory.title: Memory

output.description: Value to override output limit with, in KB.
output.title: Output

isDoubleTL.description: Whether to use double TL for this language.
isDoubleTL.title: Isdoubletl

profile.description: The profile that was used to get these limits.
profile.title: Profile

name.description: Name of the linter to run (see registry).
name.title: Name

applies_to.description: Asset kinds this linter applies to. None means all kinds.
applies_to.title: Applies To

org.description: The MOJ org to upload the package to, as `<org>#<problem>`. Leave unset to upload under your own login, which is a private personal org nobody else can see.
org.title: Org

MojLanguageExtension.description:
Language-level extensions for MOJ packaging.

Mirrors ``BocaLanguageExtension``: an rbx language declares which MOJ language ids
it maps to, and which on-disk script template to emit for them.

languages.description: MOJ language ids this rbx language maps to. The first entry is the canonical one; every entry gets its own scripts/<id>/ directory in the package.
languages.title: Languages

template.description: On-disk template dir under rbx/resources/packagers/moj/scripts/ to source the per-language compile.sh and run.sh from. Required whenever `languages` is set.
template.title: Template

flags.description: Compilation flags substituted into the template. Leave unset to use the template's own default.
flags.title: Flags

MojLanguageExtension.title: MojLanguageExtension

sandbox.description: Sandbox configuration to use when compiling for this language.

passthrough.description: Whether to pass through the compilable as an executable file.
passthrough.title: Passthrough

sandbox.description: Sandbox configuration to use when executing for this language.

formula.description:
Formula to use to calculate the time limit for the environment.
Mutually exclusive with `multipliers`. When neither is set, a default formula is
used.
formula.title: Formula

multipliers.description:
Ratios used to infer the time limit from the measured
solutions. Mutually exclusive with `formula`.

inferenceTimeout.description:
Time limit (in milliseconds) enforced on every solution run
while the time limit is estimated, whatever the estimation strategy is. A solution
expected to be too slow that hits it is dropped from the upper bound; an accepted one
that hits it is an error. Defaults to 10s.
inferenceTimeout.title: Inferencetimeout

groups.description: Groups of related languages that share an estimated time limit.
groups.title: Groups

wallTimeMultiplier.description: Default multiplier `a` in the wall-time formula `a*x + b`, where `x` is the expanded CPU time limit.
wallTimeMultiplier.title: Walltimemultiplier

wallTimeIncrement.description: Default increment `b` (in milliseconds) in the wall-time formula `a*x + b`.
wallTimeIncrement.title: Walltimeincrement

acToTimeLimit.description:
Minimum ratio between the time limit and the slowest accepted
solution, used to estimate the time limit from below: the slowest accepted solution
times `acToTimeLimit` must fit within the time limit.
acToTimeLimit.title: Actotimelimit

timeLimitToTle.description:
Minimum ratio between the fastest solution expected to be too
slow and the time limit: the time limit times `timeLimitToTle` must fit within the
fastest solution expected to be too slow. When omitted, solutions expected to be too
slow are not run and the time limit is not bounded from above.
timeLimitToTle.title: Timelimittotle

inferenceTimeout.description:
Deprecated: use `timing.inferenceTimeout`, which applies to
every estimation strategy instead of only to multiplier-based ones. Kept for
backwards compatibility; setting both is an error.
inferenceTimeout.title: Inferencetimeout

timeResolution.description:
Granularity (in milliseconds) of the estimated time limit.
The estimate is the smallest multiple of this value that is valid.
timeResolution.title: Timeresolution

defaultFileMapping.description:
Default mapping for files within the sandbox. Fields in the mapping can be
individually overridden in the language configuration.

defaultCompilation.description:
Default compilation configuration to use when compiling programs. Fields in
the compilation config can be individually overridden in the language configuration.

defaultExecution.description:
Default execution configuration to use when running programs. Fields in the
execution config can be individually overridden in the language configuration.

languages.description: Configuration for each language supported in this environment.
languages.title: Languages

sandbox.description: Identifier of the sandbox used by this environment (e.g. "stupid")
sandbox.title: Sandbox

extensions.description: Extensions to be added to the environment.

buildDir.description: Directory to store the build files.
buildDir.title: Builddir
